title: Obtrusive 'Warning case mismatch'...
body: ### Tested versions Since migrating from v4.6 to v4.7dev4, I am plagued by a host of 'false flag' Warnings', such as this one... Douglas ### System information Godot v4.7.dev4 - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GT 1030 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6094) - Intel(R) Xeon(R) CPU E5-2680 v3 @ 2.50GHz (24 threads) - 15.91 GiB memory ### Issue description  WARNING: drivers/windows/file_access_windows.cpp:192 - Case mismatch opening requested file 'res://Source/level_1_Dung_Mast.png.import', stored as 'res://Source/level_1_dung_mast.png.import' in the filesystem. This file will not open when exported to other case-sensitive platforms. I have spent several sessions cleaning up any and all 'real' case mismatches, but there are still a few dozen that I cannot find in any of my Project files. All the more frustrating as, in my particular case, and maybe others, I use Windows, where there is no issue with case for file names. As I have no intention of ever porting any Project to any other system, the Warnings are, in my case, completely redundant. It has been suggested (in the Discussion' section...) that this is a 'bug', and should not happen. Thanks in advance for any attention given to this matter (and many thanks for an excellent programming platform..!); meanwhile... Have a splendid day. ### Steps to reproduce Simply opening the Project brings up these Warnings. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [Dungeon_Master_MRP.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26791867/Dungeon_Master_MRP.zip)
